Aldanus is the guardian deity of the Aldan River, a major river in Russia's Sakha Republic. He is honored as the protector of the river, revered for his role in maintaining the delicate balance of the river's ecosystems and safeguarding its natural beauty. Aldanus is often depicted as a wise and ancient deity, with a deep connection to the river's waters and surrounding landscapes.
